go_decision: GO. goldgramprice.com uses the keyless gold-api.com feed (scripts/fetch-spot.mjs; src/data/metals.json source=gold-api.com). gold-api.com/terms (effective 2026-09-10) allows commercial use, free real-time API with no rate limit; bans several requests per second, handled by a 300 s edge cache. FX from api.frankfurter.dev v2 (free, no key, commercial use allowed, 160+ central-bank currencies). The site's optional paid keys (goldapi.io, metalpriceapi.com) are not used; no secret in the repo.
open_issues: Tola, Thai baht, chi/luong and tael constants are cited from Wikipedia; no primary source (Thai Gold Traders Association, HK CGSE, Vietnam SBV) was reachable in the time box. NIST covers grain, troy ounce, pennyweight, avoirdupois ounce.
Hong Kong gold tael 37.429 g is a rounded trade value and is marked exact:false.
goldgramprice.com has no 21K, 9K or currency pages; 21K/9K deep-link to /gold-calculator/. US city pages exist (/gold-prices/<city>/) but no tool takes a city.
Frankfurter rates are daily blended central-bank reference rates, not live FX; per-currency rate dates differ (EUR 2026-10-30, AED/INR 2026-10-29 in the fixture).
gold-api.com is a single third-party spot source with no warranty; if it is down the tools return a clear upstream error (no fallback source).
